title: Make the notes app talk
summary: Three containers that can't find each other. Put them on one network so the notes app works.

tasks.title: `web`, `api` and `db` are all running
tasks.hint: `docker ps` lists them. If one is missing, start it again with the commands from the task, plus the network you made.

tasks.title: All three are on the same network, one that you made
tasks.hint: Make a network: `docker network create notes-net`. Then plug each running container into it: `docker network connect notes-net web`, and the same for `api` and `db`. Or remove them and start them again with `--network notes-net`.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:3300` opens with no red error
tasks.hint: Read the red message. "web can't reach the api" means web and api aren't on the same network yet. "api can't reach the database" means api and db aren't.

tasks.title: You saved a note, and it shows in the list
tasks.hint: Open http://localhost:3300, type a note and press Save.
